sources.what: Naver Commerce API live response (category 50004528, KITCHEN_UTENSILS) returned: Cannot deserialize value of type `java.lang.Boolean` from String for importDeclaration. This directly establishes importDeclaration is a Boolean field. The same live observation showed releaseDate reject free-text with a date parse error at index 7, confirming it is a date-typed field (exact format still unconfirmed).

Live API 400 Boolean deserialize response, 2026-08-04. GENERAL_FOOD and DIET_FOOD probe payloads returned 'Cannot deserialize value of type `java.lang.Boolean`' for geneticallyModified and importDeclarationCheck (column location cross-referenced against the sent body to identify the field). Both are Boolean. Confirmed in both GENERAL_FOOD and DIET_FOOD. Source: live API 400 Boolean response, 2026-08-04.

Live API date format observation, 2026-08-04. packDate/consumptionDate on FOOD, GENERAL_FOOD and DIET_FOOD accepted 'yyyy-MM-dd' (a 'yyyy-MM' value failed parsing at index 7; 'yyyy-MM-dd' parsed and proceeded to the XOR stage). releaseDate on KITCHEN_UTENSILS and IMAGE_APPLIANCES accepted 'yyyy-MM' (a 'yyyy-MM-dd' value was truncated at index 7). No other type's date field format is confirmed — only the listed fields. Source: live API date format observation, 2026-08-04.

note: 확인된 것만 기록한다. 필드 이름만 보고 타입을 추측하지 않는다. 미기재 필드는 문자열(기존 동작)로 둔다. date 필드의 정확한 형식은 확인된 필드에만 기록하며, 그 외의 date 필드는 형식 미확정으로 둔다. nutritionFacts 는 문자열로 통과 실증되어 타입 파일에 넣지 않는다 (미기재=문자열이 기본).
